H2FL15241.name: Laurel Lee
H2FL15241.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 15th District; former Florida Secretary of State, Hillsborough County circuit judge, and federal prosecutor.

positions.stance: Supports finishing the border wall and expanding the Border Patrol workforce, surveillance technology to stop fentanyl smuggling, and deportation operations.
Championed permanent tax relief including the 20% small business deduction and a doubled child tax credit, and supports cutting unnecessary government spending.
Opposes efforts to defund the police and "soft-on-crime policies"; championed funding DNA testing in sexual assault cases and equipping law enforcement.
Supports expanding veterans' access to mental health care, improving job placement programs, strengthening benefits delivery, and military readiness.

H6FL15168.name: Robert People
H6FL15168.bio: Retired U.S. Army soldier who served 21 years, including three combat tours, as an ammunitions specialist and journalist.

positions.stance: Supports policies to lower utility costs and restore Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) programs.
Supports expanding clean energy investments and restoring Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) standards.
Seeks to support or introduce legislation to ban congressional stock trading.
"Health care is a human right. Period." Will support Medicare For All and universal health care.
Will not accept AIPAC donations and will vote for "NO further arms being sent to Israel under this administration."

H6FL16141.name: Sydney Gruters
H6FL16141.bio: Former Executive Director of the New College Foundation, USDA Rural Development State Director for Florida, and congressional district director and staffer.

positions.stance: "Sydney is ready to cut taxes and fight rising costs so working families can afford gas, groceries, and everyday essentials."
"Sydney will work with President Trump and ICE to keep our families safe from violent criminals entering our country illegally."
"Sydney will fight rising prices with conservative solutions that help families keep more of what they earn."
"Sydney is ready to fight for democracy and stand with President Trump to ensure our elections are secure."
"Sydney will fight to curb overdevelopment and keep homeownership within reach for working families."

H6FL16158.name: Kelly Kirschner
H6FL16158.bio: Former Mayor of Sarasota and city commissioner, Peace Corps volunteer, and founder of a non-profit helping first-generation students attend college.

positions.stance: Lower insurance, health care and drug costs by creating an insurance backstop, repealing Medicare and Medicaid cuts, and letting government negotiate prescription drug prices.
Protect the bays and coastline by prohibiting offshore drilling, stopping open-water fish farming, and enforcing the Clean Water Act.
Supports nursing, teacher preparation, veterans' education, workforce training, apprenticeships, and affordable four-year degree pathways.
On Medicare and Medicaid cuts: "Restore every cut. Protect every patient with a pre-existing condition."
Close corporate tax loopholes "and pay down the debt," putting the savings to work for working families.

H8FL17053.name: Greg Steube
H8FL17053.bio: U.S. Representative since 2018 and Army veteran; former Florida state representative and state senator.

positions.stance: Pressed federal agencies to speed permitting for hurricane recovery; "Federal bureaucracy should never become a second disaster."
Says government should help families rebuild after a hurricane, "not hand them another tax bill"; led disaster tax-relief legislation that became law.
Will "fight to cut waste, stop tax increases, expand American energy, and let families keep more of what they earn."
Has fought to give disabled veterans greater freedom to choose their health care and to ensure veterans receive the services they earned.
Supports law enforcement but opposes Flock license-plate cameras; "if the government wants to track an American, it should get a warrant."

H4FL17060.name: Matthew Montavon
H4FL17060.bio: Former official with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization for 27 years, Peace Corps volunteer, and regional planner.

positions.stance: Says Congress must immediately pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act; "Voting should be encouraged, not discouraged."
Says Congress must act to end mid-decade redistricting, which should occur every 10 years after the Census.
Says Congress must limit campaign donations and make campaign finance completely transparent; "Votes, not money, should decide elections."
Opposes cuts to veterans' services; supports access to education, job help, affordable housing, and good health care for veterans.
Opposes raising the retirement age; supports raising the tax cap on earnings and taxing all income, including capital gains, to ensure solvency.

H0FL15104.name: Scott Franklin
H0FL15104.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 18th District, U.S. Navy veteran, and former insurance business owner in Lakeland.

positions.stance: Says economic growth "starts with lower taxes, responsible spending, and a government that gets out of the way"; fighting to rein in federal spending.
Opposes raising taxes on families and small businesses, expanding federal control over health care, and "heavy handed regulations that crush American industry."
A "strong defender of the Second Amendment" who will "stand firm against attempts to weaken" it.
"Proudly pro life"; supports the Hyde Amendment and the Born Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act, and defends religious liberty.
Supports a military "fully funded, properly equipped"; focused on restoring readiness and the defense industrial base under "peace through strength."

H6FL18212.name: Curtis Gibson
H6FL18212.bio: Former city commissioner, manager of Eagle Ridge Mall, and local restaurant owner.

positions.stance: Will push for a federal reinsurance backstop to stabilize the market and bring down premium costs.
Will fight to cut red tape; if the VA cannot provide timely care close to home, veterans should have a clear path to covered local providers.
Will support policies that protect homeowners, seniors, and working families "from being taxed out of stability."
Will fight for smarter support for growers, replanting resilient citrus, and protecting agriculture from unchecked development.
Will fight for Heartland infrastructure funding and prioritize safety fixes at key choke points.

H6FL19277.name: Victor Arias
H6FL19277.bio: Attorney and owner of Arias Law Firm since 2002; former staff attorney for the Lee County and St. Lucie County school districts.

positions.stance: "Expand economic opportunity. Invest in education."
"Invest in infrastructure and education."
"Protect the environment and clean water."
"Improve access to affordable health care. Protect Medicare and Social Security for seniors."
"Cut VA red tape for veterans."

H6FL19137.name: Jim Schwartzel
H6FL19137.bio: President of Sun Broadcasting, Inc.; former staffer in Senator Connie Mack's Washington office.

positions.stance: "I'll stand with President Trump to secure our border, enforce our immigration laws and deport those who are here illegally."
Says families pay too much for groceries, housing and insurance; "I'll fight to bring those costs down."
"I'll vote to make President Trump's tax cuts permanent."
"I'll vote to cut waste and balance the budget."
Will push to cut regulations and privatize government functions, including expanding school choice and defunding the Department of Education.

H4FL20023.name: Debbie Wasserman Schultz
H4FL20023.bio: U.S. Representative since 2005 and senior member of the Appropriations Committee; former Florida state representative and state senator.

positions.stance: Has fought "to protect Social Security and Medicare."
Has fought to "defend reproductive freedom."
Has fought to "strengthen public schools."
Has fought to "lower healthcare costs."
Has fought to "prevent gun violence."

H6FL20143.name: Brent Andersen
H6FL20143.bio: Small-business owner with 16 years in the insurance industry.

positions.stance: Says Broward families are being priced out; draws on 16 years in insurance to "bring real solutions" to housing and insurance costs.
"I'll go to Washington and fight to lower the costs hitting your family every day."
"I support legal immigration, a functioning asylum system, and real protections for families who followed the rules. I oppose the chaos of open borders."
"Parents have the right to make decisions for their children. I will always vote to protect that right."
Says Washington insiders have enriched themselves; "if I wouldn't do it in front of my neighbors in Pompano Beach, I won't do it in Washington."

H6FL18097.name: Brian Mast
H6FL18097.bio: U.S. Representative and chairman of the House Foreign Affairs Committee; Army veteran of more than 12 years and former Department of Homeland Security explosives specialist.

positions.stance: Supports cutting taxes, term limits for members of Congress, a balanced budget amendment, and stronger whistleblower protections.
"I believe we must defend life at every stage"; supports prohibiting taxpayer funding for abortion and protections for infants born alive.
Supports equipping local law enforcement and "strongly oppose[s] radical efforts to defund the police"; supports school choice.
Says the right to self-defense is God-given and "I will fight to protect our Second Amendment from all attempts to erode it."
A "strong supporter of the state of Israel"; opposes the BDS movement and supports preventing a nuclear-armed Iran.

H6FL21075.name: James Martin
H6FL21075.bio: U.S. Coast Guard veteran and lieutenant commander in the Coast Guard Reserve; former Chief of Staff for National Security Affairs in the Office of the Vice President.

positions.stance: Supports ending tariffs driving up grocery prices, using antitrust laws to break up corporate consolidation, and expanding capital access for small businesses.
Supports completing Everglades restoration, cleaning up Lake Okeechobee, and stopping toxic discharges to the St. Lucie Estuary and Indian River Lagoon.
Supports getting big money out of politics, banning members of Congress from trading stocks, and closing the revolving door with lobbyists.
Believes "healthcare is a human right" and supports a public option while letting people keep union or employer coverage they like.
Supports overhauling the immigration system to be "safe, fair, transparent, and humane," including investing in immigration judges to clear asylum backlogs.

H6FL22248.name: Casey Askar
H6FL22248.bio: Chairman and CEO of Askar Family Office, a franchising, commercial real estate, energy and construction company; U.S. Marine Corps veteran.

positions.stance: "Preserving our American way of life and our God-given liberties is paramount."
Says tackling the rising cost of eggs, milk, and gas is his top priority; will work to "slash overburdening taxes and regulations."
Supports "mandatory Real ID and immigration status verification to vote" so that only American citizens can vote.
Supports banning members of Congress from stock trading and eliminating "the culture of corruption within the federal government."
Supports pushing back against Chinese aggression, funding and modernizing the military, and Trump's "peace through strength" policy.

H6FL21059.name: Pia Dandiya
H6FL21059.bio: Educator, policy advocate and tech executive; former public school teacher and founding principal of a public high school.

positions.stance: Will fight to make housing, property insurance, prescription drugs and childcare more affordable, and to "end illegal and costly tariffs."
Supports banning congressional stock trading, ending Citizens United, banning prediction-market betting by members, and congressional term limits.
Opposes cutting benefits, raising the retirement age, or privatizing Social Security; will reverse Medicaid cuts and protect Medicare.
Supports fully funded public schools, universal pre-K, and expanded job training and apprenticeships.
"I will fight to make sure all personal healthcare decisions stay between a woman and her doctor."

H2FL14053.name: Lois Frankel
H2FL14053.bio: U.S. Representative and member of the House Appropriations Committee; former mayor and state legislator.

positions.stance: Supports legislation to reduce prescription drug prices, make housing more affordable, extend Affordable Care Act tax credits, and lower taxes for families with children.
Has fought against efforts to cut Medicare and Medicaid and "rejected efforts to privatize Social Security."
Opposes efforts to make voting more difficult; supports the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and defends vote-by-mail.
"A life-long supporter of women's right to an abortion, birth control, and all reproductive health care"; a lead sponsor of the Women's Health Protection Act.
Supports security assistance to Israel and aid to civilians in Gaza, and works toward "a comprehensive two-state solution."

H2FL21132.name: Deborah Adeimy
H2FL21132.bio: Finance professional holding a FINRA Series 7 securities license.

positions.stance: Supports legal immigration but says "illegal and forced entry" strains the welfare system, hospitals and schools; opposes an "open border strategy."
Says "inflation is taxation without legislation" and "Americans know how to spend their earned income better than Government."
Says home ownership must be protected from outside developers; pledges to work with Rep. Brian Mast on solutions to save Florida's waters.
Supports pharmaceutical research and says affordable health care is possible "when insurance companies and drug manufacturers work together."
"The space race is on again – The United States must lead and defend that frontier."

H6FL14203.name: Mayonna Te Brown
H6FL14203.bio: Businesswoman, real estate developer, and former teacher.

positions.stance: Supports redirecting federal housing dollars from lifelong rental subsidies toward helping low-income families buy their first home.
Supports putting federal education dollars "directly in the hands of parents by funding students, not systems."
Supports H-1B reforms that prioritize American workers, require competitive wages, crack down on abuse, and reserve visas for genuine high-skill shortages.
Supports "faster care, real mental health support, and full accountability at the VA" for veterans.
Supports securing the southern border and removing criminals, while creating "a clear, lawful process for people who have earned the right to remain."

H6FL24095.name: Oliver Gilbert
H6FL24095.bio: Former Mayor of Miami Gardens and Miami-Dade County Commissioner.

positions.stance: Will "fight for a pathway to ensure that healthcare is a right for every American."
Supports eliminating income taxes for working families through tax policies indexed to what families earn, and more IRS auditing of the ultra-wealthy.
Calls to "Stop ICE Raids Now" and end funding for deportation policies, redirecting the money into communities.
Supports universal childcare and pre-K, redirecting spending toward children and families.
Will fight to secure federal funding so residents get the transit solutions they have been promised.

H2FL22171.name: Jared Moskowitz
H2FL22171.bio: U.S. Representative and member of the House Foreign Affairs and Judiciary Committees; former Director of Florida's Division of Emergency Management.

positions.stance: Authored legislation to cut homeowners' property insurance premiums; has fought to lower prescription drug prices and expand affordable housing.
Fighting "every effort to weaken or privatize" Social Security and Medicare, and working to strengthen Medicare and lower drug costs.
Fighting to defend and strengthen the Affordable Care Act and restore the enhanced ACA tax credits that expired.
Helped pass Florida's red flag protections and raising the gun-buying age to 21; sponsors bills to strengthen emergency response and keep schools safe.
Calls out antisemitism in both parties and has "staunchly defended Israel," saying the U.S.-Israel relationship "must be defended."

H6FL23188.name: Scott Singer
H6FL23188.bio: Former Mayor of Boca Raton; lawyer and small business owner.

positions.stance: Supports slashing overregulation, putting Trump executive-order gains into law, and energy independence to reduce costs.
Strongly supports Trump's efforts to secure the border and stands with local law enforcement; says "public safety is the first function of government."
Will ensure military personnel receive the support and training they need and work to take care of veterans "at all stages of their lives."
Will "oppose efforts to increase tax rates" and work to continue cutting wasteful spending.
Will sponsor laws to make Trump economic policies permanent and "oppose all actions of the radical left to institute debilitating socialist policies."

H2FL25018.name: Mario Díaz-Balart
H2FL25018.bio: U.S. Representative for eleven terms and Vice Chair of the House Appropriations Committee; former Florida state legislator for fourteen years.

positions.stance: Supports no tax on tips or overtime, permanent tax cuts for working families, and relief for seniors.
Supports school violence prevention funding, "tougher laws against online predators, and reinforced parental rights in education."
"Detaining and removing criminal aliens, cracking down on fentanyl trafficking, and backing the men and women who enforce our laws."
Supports manufacturing jobs "with expanded tax relief and renewed Opportunity Zones."
"Standing with political prisoners and dissidents in exile. Defending freedom in our hemisphere. Rejecting authoritarianism."

H6FL26058.name: Nicole Locklin
H6FL26058.bio: Attorney; Lead Counsel at technology company Databricks and former litigation associate.

positions.stance: "I will fight price-gouging, lower essential costs, protect consumers, and make billionaires and large corporations pay their fair share."
Will confront insurance companies, protect renters from extreme increases, build more affordable housing, and stop corporate investors from buying up neighborhoods.
"I will oppose benefit cuts, privatization, and attempts to raise the retirement age."
"I will not support another unnecessary or unauthorized war"; will put diplomacy first and oppose "blank checks for governments that violate human rights."
"I will fight to restore abortion rights nationwide and protect access to contraception, fertility treatment, and emergency reproductive care."

H8FL27185.name: María Elvira Salazar
H8FL27185.bio: U.S. Representative for Florida's 27th District; former award-winning journalist who reported across Latin America.

positions.stance: Committed to ensuring South Florida has modern infrastructure, including flood mitigation, stormwater, road and bridge, water and sewer, and port investments.
Champions sanctions against dictators and their enablers and has fought to keep pressure on the Cuban, Maduro and Ortega regimes.
Has voted to lower taxes, supported tax relief for working families, and fought to help small businesses grow and create jobs.
"We must set limits on how long public servants can serve in Washington."
Committed to strengthening the health care system, expanding children's mental health services, and protecting programs that train new doctors.
Priorities include converting underused federal land into affordable housing, enforcing antitrust laws in groceries, and a federal backstop for homeowners insurance.
Will oppose privatizing or cutting Medicare and Social Security or raising the retirement age; supports a voluntary Medicare buy-in for ages 55 to 64.
Supports a secure border and removing genuine threats, faster immigration processing, protecting Dreamers, and comprehensive reform for law-abiding immigrants.
Supports banning members of Congress and the Executive Branch from trading individual stocks, strong ethics rules, and transparency in the Epstein investigation.
"No president is above the law"; will defend free and fair elections and reassert Congress's authority over spending, war powers, and executive action.

H0FL26036.name: Carlos Giménez
H0FL26036.bio: Former Mayor of Miami-Dade County, Miami city manager, and Miami Fire-Rescue chief after 25 years as a firefighter.

H4FL28042.name: Phil Ehr
H4FL28042.bio: Retired U.S. Navy Commander with a 26-year active-duty career.

positions.stance: Supports lowering premiums, expanding access, and reducing out-of-pocket costs through the Healthcare Stability & Program Choice Act.
Supports enforcing anti-fraud laws, holding bad actors accountable, stabilizing the market, and protecting homeowners from rising costs.
Supports recommitting to the Constitution and the rule of law and using military force "only when it is lawful and necessary."
Supports creating an inter-agency public corruption task force and strengthening accountability for public contracts.
Will pursue a full VA hospital or major VA medical facility in South Dade to improve access for veterans in South Dade and Monroe County.
